legacyFederalEntry.rule: Do not duplicate or re-enable the hidden legacy tile.

categories.title: Locations and districts
categories.acceptance: Saved facility/address, House/state districts, resolution method and evidence; incomplete address must not imply verified geography.

categories.title: Client economic footprint
categories.acceptance: Planned/estimated/current employment remain distinct. Period, currency, geographic basis and supporting record accompany payroll/investment/tax/supplier/spend measures.

categories.title: Unemployment
categories.acceptance: ACS five-year district estimates require dataset year, unemployed population, civilian labor force, rate and retrieval/coverage; district figures are not client employment.

categories.title: Workforce and commuting
categories.acceptance: Validated district aggregates only; absent LODES is explicitly unavailable, not inferred from facility staff previews.

categories.title: Representation and committees
categories.acceptance: Current representative/senators and committees follow verified geography and source freshness.

categories.title: Contracts and grants
categories.acceptance: Require recipient identity and geographic attribution; show DoD-contract/all-agency-assistance coverage. Opportunities remain separate potential funding.

categories.title: Strategic relevance
categories.acceptance: Use actual linked Objective/capability/PE/bill/target/Strategy references; physical presence alone creates no score or policy alignment.

categories.title: Member priorities
categories.acceptance: Public office/fiscal-year/project/request-outcome stage/source; public priority is not automatically a client award.

categories.title: Engagement context
categories.acceptance: Only matched office relationships/outreach/shared meetings/next actions; general client activity must not be attributed to the location.

categories.title: Changes and evidence
categories.acceptance: Keep observation, reporting period, retrieval date and review status distinct; missing is not zero; stale values preserve period; conflicts require review.

missingDesignStates.request: Show loading; whole-modal failure+retry; independently failed/unavailable section; permission-revoked or location moved while open. Preserve map selection and do not reveal a forbidden record.

Show one verified populated example plus stale, conflicting and manual-review cases with reporting period, dataset vintage, retrievedAt and geographic basis separately. Use clearly synthetic examples.

Supply the structured economic evidence entry/edit/import-review/error/unknown-save dialog or drawer referenced by Add supported figures copy. Current inspected frames provide descriptive text, not a complete form workflow.

Supply consolidated identity/federal-tab loading, no authorized match, source failure, partial coverage, stale/conflicting identity match and permission states. Keep program funding context distinct from attributed awards.

scopeLimits: No ingestion/data aggregation/native API fact verification by this lane.
No claims that ACS/LODES/source data exist or are complete.
No production Figma mutation, frontend source edit, browser/compiler/test or live product call.
